title: hearty post-workout kenyan beef stew
description: nutty, chewy, post-workout dish made with grilled beef, makrut lime leaves, and a blend of spices.
instructions: heat the coconut oil in the hot pot over medium-high heat.
add the beef and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
remove the beef from the pot and set aside.
add the chopped onions to the pot and cook until they start to caramelize, about 5 minutes.
add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
add the chopped makrut lime leaves, ground ginger, ground cumin, salt, and black pepper to the pot and cook for 1 minute.
add the browned beef back to the pot and stir to coat with the spice mixture.
add 2 cups of beef broth to the pot and bring to a boil.
reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 2 hours, or until the beef is tender.
serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro if desired.
